what_it_is.prose: Elbit Systems is Israel's largest defence electronics company and a key India UAV partner through its Adani-Elbit joint venture ('Adani Elbit Advanced Systems India Ltd'), which opened India's first private-sector UAV manufacturing facility in Hyderabad in December 2018. The JV produces the Hermes 900 MALE UAV, marketed in India as the 'Drishti-10' Starliner; the Indian Navy formally received its first Drishti-10 long-endurance UAV in January 2024. The same JV has supplied 20+ Hermes-900 airframes to Israel (IAF) amid the Gaza war, drawing scrutiny. Elbit's Hermes 900 has reportedly suffered operational crashes/glitches in Indian service (2025-26), with additional crashes reported in Switzerland. Elbit has also won Asia-Pacific naval contracts (e.g., Seagull USV in January 2021) that may include India.

faq.question: Which Elbit Systems UAV is built in India?
faq.answer: The Hermes 900 MALE UAV is co-produced in India by the Adani-Elbit joint venture ('Adani Elbit Advanced Systems India Ltd') at Hyderabad — India's first private-sector UAV manufacturing facility, inaugurated in December 2018. The platform is marketed to the Indian Navy as the 'Drishti-10' Starliner; the first unit was formally delivered to the Navy on 10 January 2024.

faq.question: What is the Adani-Elbit joint venture called?
faq.answer: The JV is 'Adani Elbit Advanced Systems India Ltd', inaugurated in Hyderabad in December 2018. It is India's first private UAV manufacturing facility and produces the Hermes 900 (Drishti-10) MALE UAV; it has also exported 20+ Hermes-900 airframes to Israel.

faq.question: Has Elbit's Hermes 900 had any operational issues in India?
faq.answer: Yes. The Jerusalem Post reported in January 2025 on 'glitches for Elbit's Hermes 900 in India and Switzerland', and Calcalist CTech reported in July 2026 that a Hermes 900 crashed again in India — indicating recurring operational issues with the platform in Indian service.
